liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (3 reviews): Called the show's real standout, one of the best versions the reviewer has heard; During the Northbound Train section, Phil drops some things [18][23][24]
- **Hey Pocky Way** (2 reviews): The Hey Pocky Way into Playin' into Rider stretch is named the show's highlight; Played very tight and with high energy [15][20]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Weir plays notably cool licks late in the song, audible if you listen closely [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-08-05.177549.unknown.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1989-08-05.senn441.coniff.gmb.92636.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 145 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd89-08-05.sbd.18256.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 152 min; rated 4.17/5 by 12 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer doubts it is a soundboard: crowd voices are upfront and the sound is flanged and compressed; Noticeable wow and flutter give an underwater, slightly off-key sound like mid-70s trades [25]
- **gd1989-08-05.163643.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 17 songs; 153 min [6]
- **gd89-08-05.schoeps.3871.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 16 songs; 141 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [10]. Said about its sound: Schoeps audience tape is great and captures the band's high energy that night [19]
- **gd89-08-05.set2-sbd.miller.13206.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 87 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [14]. Said about its sound: This set-two source has persistent static from a hi-hat; the reviewer recommends the other version [21]

## Around the show

- Hot day; the reviewer spotted Bill Graham cruising around on a motorbike [15]
- Reviewer split a grilled cheese sandwich with Bill Walton at the show [17]
- Reviewer attended every Summer '89 show from Shoreline in June through this run [19]
- Reviewer ranks this Terrapin alongside a 1/7/79 version as the strongest they know [18]
- The July RFK show had a similar standard setlist and was also played very well [19]
- Early second set shows what the band with Brent could do at its peak [20]
- Reviewer says no Terrapin was played on 1/7/79 at MSG, disputing another reviewer's comparison [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-08-05.177549.unknown.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bill Bradt's Master Audience Cassettes; Unknown Gear (likely Nakamichi 700 (Left/Right) + Neumann KM84i (Center) blend > unknown mixer) > Sony D5M (Maxell… [1]. Also: Schoeps CMC44 source from Ted Mattes and Lance Deal supplies two short patches in Space [1]
- **gd1989-08-05.senn441.coniff.gmb.92636.flac16**: taped by Casey Coniff; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Sennheiser 441 > Marantz PDM 340 w/ dbx Cassette Master Maxell MX-S 90 Recorded in front of Repeater Stack [3]. Also: Crossfades cover tape flips after Memphis Blues, during Space, and during the NFA chant [3]
- **gd89-08-05.sbd.18256.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > C > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN via Darryl Hinko [4]. Also: Reviewer insists it is a soundboard, citing Healy's matrix recordings of the period [26]
- **gd1989-08-05.163643.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  February 11, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [6]
- **gd89-08-05.schoeps.3871.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Schoeps MK2 (spread) > dat > cdr [10]
- **gd89-08-05.set2-sbd.miller.13206.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 2 SBD> CM> DAT> CD> EAC> SHN [14]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by antelopecrossing.blogspot.com: [more GRATEFUL DEAD SBDs 1989](https://antelopecrossing.blogspot.com/2010/12/more-grateful-dead-sbds-1989.html) [28]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1989-08-05 Cal Expo, Sacramento, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-08-05-cal-expo-sacramento-ca-usa/) [29]
